headline: Violations in Insurance-Pension Fund Finances Could Incur Fines of Rp25 M per Person
summary: Indonesia's financial services regulator OJK banned manipulation of financial reports by directors and employees of insurers, guarantors and pension funds. Violators may face fines of Rp25 million per person.
why: The OJK supervises Indonesia's insurance, pension and capital markets, so its enforcement affects governance and disclosure standards at financial institutions.
original_headline: Poles Lapkeu Asuransi-Dana Pensiun Bisa Kena Denda Rp25 M per Orang
